verdict.rationale: A GPU is fairly driven through a vendor programming API, and NVIDIA documents the CUDA Toolkit for that purpose: a runtime library, C/C++ compiler, cuTile Python and C++ tile-kernel programming, GPU-accelerated libraries, and Nsight tools. The evidence is high-level marketing copy that never explicitly ties CUDA support to the RTX 5070 Ti, and the OpenAPI probes found no machine-readable API spec. Missing for 10: explicit RTX 5070 Ti / Blackwell support in the API docs, a documented device control and monitoring API (e.g., clocks, power, telemetry), a machine-readable API spec for agent consumption, and hands-on corroboration of programmatic control.
